notes.title: Q&A with Hot Chili Games - Developers of Elypse
notes.content:
[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/09cfdd593bd2462c1b961d766dab523de010823a.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/6d06f8fe0436df090012b02dfc2ea4387a41f3c8.png[/img][/url]

[h1]So we had a lot of questions from the players who tried the game or heard about Elypse. We decided to pick and combine the most commonly asked questions from the community and here they are:[/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/0bc338e95c281370c6a2381064291d6a12748a8f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Is Elypse a Metroidvania?[/h2]
We got asked this question a lot and there were some initial misunderstandings/miscommunication and assumptions that it was a Metroidvania when the game was initially announced. We would just like to emphasize the fact that we never wanted to call it a Metroidvania and tried to avoid using the term. But everyone knows how the digital space is out of our control as a small team of indie game devs.

Honestly speaking, we drew inspirations from celebrated titles, including Ori and the Blind Forest, which influenced the aerial aspect of the controller, providing a sense of freedom and fluidity in movement. Celeste served as a structural blueprint, shaping the game's platforming challenges, and delivering a captivating narrative that unfolds with each step of the adventure. Taking cues from Super Meat Boy, Elypse features a dynamic controller and the exhilarating die-and-retry aspect, ensuring an adrenaline-fueled experience that will keep players hooked.

We tried our best infusing Elypse with their spirit while adding our own innovative gameplay elements. It's a fusion of platforming, challenging gameplay and storytelling that offers players a fresh and challenging adventure. While Elypse shares some artistic similarities with metroidvania games, it is more of an action-adventure 2D-Platformer, and we tried to offer a unique experience that sets it apart.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/b4db4279f2f3f4392ef17e741e1a9cd40b10263f.jpg[/img]

[h2]How many years and people did it take to work on Elypse?[/h2]
The journey of developing Elypse has been an incredible one, shaped by the passion and dedication of the talented team at Hot Chili Games. Over the course of two years, a close-knit group of friends and developers poured their hearts and souls into this project. Hot Chili Games, founded in 2020, brought together individuals who shared a common vision and an unwavering commitment to creating remarkable gaming experiences. 

We were five people in total, 1 producer, 2 artists and 2 developers. The actual game development took about 18 months. Through countless hours of hard work, collaboration, and overcoming challenges, Elypse has evolved into a labor of love that showcases the team's talent, creativity, and determination. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/865e3d9c5b5dedb2a51316faefb4924de12b663c.jpg[/img]

[h2]When is the console version coming out and does the PC version of the game support controllers and Steamdeck?[/h2]
Yes, the game has been out on PC since 17 May 2023, and it does support controllers. It is available on Steam, GoG, Epic stores. I think we got some player feedback about the game running smoothly on their Steamdeck. Also, we would like to add here that a lot of people were looking for the demo and as per tradition/usual, we took off the demo on the day of the release. 

Regarding the PlayStation and Nintendo Switch versions, while it's not officially confirmed, I can share with our curious and supportive community that they can expect it very soon, possibly within the next month.

[h1]If you have any other questions for the devs, don't hesitate to ask on the social channels.[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/ZMeTjqb6tX][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/641db702515bb689d839d355b45a983221c01fe8.png[/img][/url]
[h1][url=https://twitter.com/Hot_Chili_Games]Twitter: @Hot_Chili_Games[/url][/h1]

[h1]If you still haven't tried the game, here is the Steam Page:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725340/Elypse/

notes.title: The Countdown Begins!
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Uncover the captivating STORY📖 of Elypse!  [/h1]

[h3]Prepare for an emotional rollercoaster as you witness the power of determination and hope. Immerse yourself in a tale of sacrifice, destiny, and defying the odds. Join our brave heroine as she fights against the darkness and attempt to save herself and her people from the Abyss. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/1ed5ea14c9d9df48fba334540b243aa509fbdb37.png[/img]

[h3]Fay is a young servant of the imperial palace, She never knew her parents and has always grown up attending the Celestial court. Every ten years, a sacrifice is made by the emperor at the portal of the Abyss in order to maintain its seal and prevent creatures from leaving that world.

As a young adult, Fay finds herself designated to be sacrificed during the next ceremony. Determined to die for her people, she submits to her fate and dives into the Abyss, terrified but proud to know that she is saving her folks.

It was without being warned that it was not death awaiting her on the other side... But an adventure that would take her beyond anything Fay could have ever expected, accompanied by her future companion in misfortune, Nyx.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/a73b03d0d82e6ad23463f4da8f84172a7dd9c3a7.png[/img]

Nyx is a sky traveler who lost his people in an Abyss-related cataclysm.​
Wandering from city to city to learn more about the origin and manipulation of dark energy.​

Welcomed by the emperor of the Celestial people, Nyx was finally designated as the next sacrifice. ​
After many decades he will meet Fay, shattering the perspectives of the bitterly lonely man...​
[/h3]

[h2]🌟Only 2 days left until the release of Elypse! 🌟 [/h2]

[h3]The excitement is reaching its peak as we prepare to launch this 2D platformer. Sharpen your skills, gather your courage, and get ready to face the challenges that await you in the Abyss. It's time to show the world what you're made of! Let's make this a launch to remember! 🚀💥[/h3]

We don't have much ressources as we are a very small team with few time on our hands, but we will do our best to improve Elypse game experience based upon the feedback we are gathering.

We will keep you posted about our successes in this matter right here and on our discord!

- Hot Chili Games.

notes.title: /!\ Framerate issues information /!\
notes.content:
Hello gamers !

Thank you for all the feedbacks you guys are giving, it is really valuable for us.

We are sorry and are aware about framerate issues and other bugs. We are currently hard working on the optimization front to get a game that fits most configurations.
Unfortunately these issues can't be fixed for this demo, but we will do our best to address them. We will also provide you with options to tweak the graphics in the full release.
Also, note that we use high definition & quality textures that are quite demanding sometimes. You will most likely encounter some framerate drops if you're playing in 2K resolution or above without a high-end GPU.
In the meantime, we recommend you to play the game on 1080p if you are having issues.

Thank you and best regards,
Hot Chili Games.

notes.title: The mysterious Beggar
notes.content:
Nicknamed "Beggar" by Fay during their first encounter, you will meet this mysterious character during your journey.

Trading souls echoes for useful magic and trinkets, he is out there all along your ascension, making it easier for you to get through the dangers of the Abyss.
Collect echoes along your adventure and mitigate difficulty using the help of the "Beggar"!

But beware... Fay and Nyx do not know his intentions.
This is up to you to discover! Will you get to the bottom of this mystery?

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/1f9d691544cdf97a8487aa117d6aeab348dabd22.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet sky traveler Nyx!
notes.content:
Nyx is a sky traveler who lost his people in an Abyss-related cataclysm, wandering from city to city to learn more about the origin and manipulation of dark energy.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/a73b03d0d82e6ad23463f4da8f84172a7dd9c3a7.png[/img]

This is how the emperor of the Celestial people welcomed him, with the idea of instilling hope in his people and maintaining his influence. As Nyx slowly came closer to the truth, the ruler designated him as the next sacrifice. He found himself wandering, consumed more and more by the Abyss until he was nothing but a soul.

After many decades he will meet Fay, shattering the perspectives of the bitterly lonely man...

If you want to get all the update about Elypse, follow and wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725340/Elypse/

notes.title: Meet imperial servant Fay!
notes.content:
Fay is a young servant of the imperial palace, She never knew her parents and has always grown up attending the Celestial court. Every ten years, a sacrifice is made by the emperor at the portal of the Abyss in order to maintain its seal and prevent creatures from leaving that world.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/1ed5ea14c9d9df48fba334540b243aa509fbdb37.png[/img]

As a young adult, Fay finds herself designated to be sacrificed during the next ceremony. Determined to die for her people, she submits to her fate and dives into the Abyss, terrified but proud to know that she is saving her folks.
It was without being warned that it was not death awaiting her on the other side... But an adventure that would take her beyond anything Fay could have ever expected, accompanied by her future companion in misfortune, Nyx...

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/feac2086b2ed997433c6ca1f8ce38b725a4c4fa6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Elypse's gameplay
notes.content:
Let's take a look at Elypse's base gameplay! The Abyss is not a welcoming place, you'll have to adapt to your environment to get through this ordeal.
 Let's jump right to it with Fay

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/045023e86e1f75c9436b1f157d3878d212dbe0a2.gif[/img]

Before going further into the Abyss you'll have to unlock your dashes!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/a58c565770fcb5a31f2d4636ecd9918c9167f436.gif[/img]

Earn more dashes throughout your journey and take advantage of your speed to reach your way out of the Abyss. You can't reach this platform in the distance? You might need an additionnal dash to get to it!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/85320a5945f24df8b270f83713dc64aedf8e4028.gif[/img]

Your adventure in the Abyss won't be all peaceful with enemies inhabiting the environment doing everything they can to stop you. Face enemies and get rid of some wall protections with your slash!
 
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/7779cb2e1b10431d7459d61e2bcf8a39764d49f8.gif[/img]

Interested in Elypse's dynamic gameplay? You can follow and wishlist the game on Steam here :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725340/Elypse/

notes.title: Escape from the Abyss
notes.content:
Long ago in the Celestial world, a great portal was opened. A gateway leading to a dimension as frightening as it was mysterious, sucking in all life that approached it and closely linked to it... the Abyss.

And so a dark ritual was born... The Celestials began to feed the portal one of their kind every decade in order to keep the vortex in balance and protect Celestial society.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/e33ee5eeeecfbef52e2eb42a7f59cc3a501ee424.gif[/img]

In this world, you will be Fay. A young woman of the Celestial people designated as the next sacrifice.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/d486dcc35e13830e66a1f6569441d6f0536ad028.gif[/img]

Escape from the Abyss by surviving the traps, enemies that you will encounter while revealing your powers and discover the dark story that lies behind these places.

notes.title: Who we are and Games Made In France participation
notes.content:
Elypse will be showcased in a few days! We'll be participating at the Games Made In France between September 22nd and 25th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41305550/80b5929efe762c46fea03ac4a56384714e4d3608.jpg[/img]

The Games Made In France showcases games developed or published in France. Hot Chili Games is a company based in France created by a team of fresh graduates from a video game university.
After a last internship for their studies, they managed, thanks to a collaboration with PID Games, to persue what was once their student project and became their professionnal goal:

The platformer with metroidvania mechanics Elypse. The Hot Chili team has been working on Elypse and perfecting it for a year now 🔥🌶 

Don't want to miss out on the exact timing of the event? Follow and wishlist the game on Steam :
